# freshdesk_skills (Data Source)

Every routing skill on the helpdesk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_skills" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `skills`.
- `skills` (Attributes List) Every skill the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skills))

<a id="nestedatt--skills"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skills`

Read-Only:

- `agent_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the agents who hold the skill.
- `conditions` (String) Matching rules, as JSON.
- `created_at` (String) When the skill was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the skill.
- `match_type` (String) Whether all or any conditions must match.
- `name` (String) Name of the skill.
- `rank` (Number) Evaluation order of the skill.
- `updated_at` (String) When the skill was last changed (RFC 3339).
